name: Python v2 unscored scenario set
provenance: Agent-authored synthetic scenarios labelled against the existing corpus before running retrieval. Not sourced from real posts or independently labelled. Prior results informed topic selection.

questions.question: The shop insists I can only complain in the city where it is based. I work full-time in another city. Is that location relevant?
The District Commission ruled against me yesterday. Which commission hears a challenge to that order?
I bought a fridge and the commission accepted my complaint. What happens after it gets admitted?
Both sides agreed to settle in mediation. What happens to the signed agreement and the pending case?
The online marketplace won't tell me where the seller is based after I wrote to ask. Where can I read about that?
The marketplace keeps sending canned replies. How quickly is its grievance officer supposed to acknowledge a complaint?
My online refund was accepted but the money hasn't come. Does the rule itself give a fixed number of days?
At checkout the app quietly added a small charity payment to my order. What guidance covers this?
The countdown on a deal restarts every time I reload the page. Which online shopping guidance covers false time pressure?
An ad said the sample was free, but I had to pay a handling fee. What guidance covers that claim?
How can I search for a commission order online, and can you tell me what the commission awarded in my neighbour's case?
questions.unsupported_part: The specific case and its outcome are not supplied or indexed.
